zara (CS): Heads up  Lighthouse Analytics (account: lighthouse-analytics) just asked for region-specific egress pinning + a temporary QPS lift for an investor demo. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4412
rahul (Infra): Details? Which regions and what IP ranges / hostnames do they need pinned?
zara (CS): They want EU edge only for data residency: SNI `api.lighthouse-analytics.com` + CIDR 198.51.100.0/25. Demo tomorrow needs 1k QPS for 6 hours (auto-revoke). Also asked to whitelist our Tokyo edge for a small team pilot in APAC: SNI `apac.api.lighthouse-analytics.com` + CIDR 198.51.101.0/26.
tom (Eng): Okay we can add two ACL entries and a temporary rate window. Confirm: are these origins going through our proxy or direct peering?
zara (CS): Through proxy -> they requested a screenshot of routing after changes and a short note about log retention (30 days) for compliance. They may request CMK later.
rahul (Infra): I'll stage changes to canary-eu then canary-apac. Sample payload I'll apply in ACL manager:
```
{
  "entries": [
    {"region": "eu", "sni": "api.lighthouse-analytics.com", "cidr": "198.51.100.0/25", "qps": 1000, "window": "2025-04-12T09:00Z/2025-04-12T15:00Z", "autorevoke": true},
    {"region": "apac", "sni": "apac.api.lighthouse-analytics.com", "cidr": "198.51.101.0/26", "qps": 50, "note": "pilot"
    }
  ],
  "requested_by": "zara (CS)",
  "ticket": "CS-4412"
}
```
rahul (Infra): Will roll canary eu first, verify routing and logs, then apac. ops-bot can you schedule the canary windows?
ops-bot: Scheduled: canary-eu ACL update at 2025-04-12T08:50Z, canary-apac ACL update at 2025-04-12T10:00Z.
tom (Eng): If they escalate to CMK for logs, we need legal + security signoff. For now confirm we redact sensitive payloads and only provide request metadata in screenshots.
sophia (Acct): Noted renewal sensitivity  they said trial ends 2025-04-20. I'll book a check-in for 2025-04-18 to review how the demo went and surface any compliance asks.
zara (CS): Also asked for a short how-to for their infra team: "how to verify SNI and egress IPs on their side"  I'll draft a one-pager and attach to the ticket.
rahul (Infra): Canary-eu started... applying 198.51.100.0/25 and SNI rule.
ops-bot: Canary-eu deploy complete  3/3 healthy. Trace: https://logs.redwood.example/lighthouse-analytics/2845678901/eu
rahul (Infra): Attached a sanitized request trace and a screenshot of route table. Pinging zara for customer share.
zara (CS): Sharing now  customer confirmed the demo slot is covered and appreciated the quick turnaround. They asked us to set the QPS autorevoke reminder + to confirm the APAC pilot has no SLA change.
sophia (Acct): I'll confirm SLA note in the contract addendum and update renewal risk as "lowered" for now.
tom (Eng): Great  remind customer we can enable CMK for logs but need procurement lead time.
zara (CS): Closing loop  will mark ticket CS-4412 with resolution and follow-ups for CMK discussion post-demo. :white_check_mark:
